title: Launchers from alternative locations(e.g. ~/Desktop) are not identified correctly, duplication of windows etc.
line: Apps pinned from a renamed .desktop file, such as a copy on the desktop, no longer get a second task manager icon when running.
explanation: A launcher pinned from a .desktop file outside the application dirs got its app id from its own file name (konsole), while the app's window is mapped to the installed application (org.kde.konsole). The task manager matches launchers and windows by app id or launcher URL, and neither matched, so the running app got a second icon. Copies that kept the installed file name already worked. The launcher model now gives such a launcher the app id of the installed application with the same Exec line, when no installed application has its own name.

commits.message:
libtaskmanager: match renamed .desktop launchers to their windows

A launcher pinned from a renamed copy of a .desktop file, e.g. on the
desktop, used the file name as its app id, so its windows never matched
it. Use the installed application with the same Exec line instead.

BUG: 403983

media.caption: Master: launcher pinned from ~/Desktop/konsole.desktop clicked; Konsole opens as a second icon next to the launcher.
Fixed: the same click turns the pinned launcher into the running Konsole task, one icon.
Master: pinned launcher, Konsole not running.
Fixed: after closing Konsole the launcher is back as before.
Master: the running Konsole gets its own icon.
Fixed: Konsole started from outside the task manager also takes the pinned launcher's place.

reviews.text: Targeted, well-cached fix in LauncherTasksModel that resolves renamed local .desktop launchers outside XDG application directories to the matching installed application's desktopEntryName via KApplicationTrader on identical Exec lines. The lookup is restricted to local non-installed launchers whose own filename isn't an installed app, cached alongside appDataCache, and properly invalidated on KSycoca updates and launcher removal. Autotests pass and the before/after screenshots confirm single-icon matching both when launched from the pin and externally.
